items.prompt:
Finish the opinion sentence. Circle the better ending.

'I think apples are the best fruit because they are _____.'

A) green
B) sweet and crunchy

steps: A reason explains WHY something is good. 'Green' just names a color. 'Sweet and crunchy' tells why apples are the best.

items.prompt:
Which sentence is an opinion?

A) Dogs have four legs.
B) I think dogs are the best pets.
items.answer: B) I think dogs are the best pets.

steps: An opinion is what someone thinks or believes. 'I think dogs are the best pets' uses the opinion word 'I think.' Sentence A is a fact.

items.prompt:
Finish this sentence with a reason:

'I think recess is important because _____.'

A) it is in the afternoon
B) it helps kids move their bodies
items.answer: B) it helps kids move their bodies

steps: The reason must explain WHY recess is important. 'It helps kids move their bodies' is a good reason. 'It is in the afternoon' just tells the time.

items.prompt:
Which word starts an opinion sentence?

A) The
B) I think

steps: Opinion sentences start with words like 'I think,' 'I believe,' or 'In my opinion.' 'The' starts a fact sentence.

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence:

'I think ___ is better than ice cream because it is healthier.'

A) fruit
B) cold

steps: The blank needs a topic that can be compared to ice cream. 'Fruit' makes sense as a food topic. 'Cold' is an adjective, not a topic.

items.prompt:
A student wrote: 'Pizza is yummy.' Is this a complete opinion sentence?

A) Yes, it has an opinion word and a reason.
B) No, it is missing an opinion word like 'I think' and a reason.
items.answer: B) No, it is missing an opinion word like 'I think' and a reason.

steps: A complete opinion sentence needs an opinion word (I think) and a reason (because...). 'Pizza is yummy' has neither.

items.prompt:
Which sentence has a closing?

A) I think books are fun because you can learn new things.
B) I think books are fun because you can learn new things. That is why everyone should read.
items.answer: B) I think books are fun because you can learn new things. That is why everyone should read.

steps: A closing sentence wraps up the writing. 'That is why everyone should read' is a closing. Sentence A stops after the reason.

items.prompt:
Finish this opinion sentence:

'I believe winter is the best season because you can _____.'
items.answer: I believe winter is the best season because you can play in the snow.

steps: Think of something fun to do in winter. 'Play in the snow' is a good reason that connects to winter.

items.prompt:
Which word best fills the blank?

'I think we should have art class _____ it is fun and helps us be creative.'

A) but
B) because

steps: The word 'because' connects an opinion to its reason. 'But' shows a contrast, not a reason.

items.prompt: Write a complete opinion sentence about your favorite season. Use 'I think' and 'because.'
items.answer: I think summer is the best season because you can swim and play outside all day.

steps: Start with 'I think,' name your favorite season, then add 'because' and a reason.

items.prompt:
Which sentence gives a reason?

A) I think lunch is the best part of school.
B) I think lunch is the best part of school because I get to eat my favorite food and talk with my friends.
items.answer: B) I think lunch is the best part of school because I get to eat my favorite food and talk with my friends.

steps: The word 'because' signals the reason. Sentence B has 'because' followed by reasons. Sentence A states the opinion only.

items.prompt:
Circle the opinion word in this sentence:

'I believe cats are better than dogs because they are quiet and easy to care for.'

steps: Opinion words tell the reader that what follows is the writer's personal view. 'I believe' is the opinion word here.

items.prompt:
What does a closing sentence do?

A) It gives a new reason.
B) It wraps up the opinion writing.
items.answer: B) It wraps up the opinion writing.

steps: A closing sentence ends the writing by restating the opinion or summarizing. It does not introduce new reasons.

items.prompt:
Finish this opinion paragraph with a closing sentence:

'I think school is important because you learn to read and write. _____.'
items.answer: That is why I think every child should go to school.

steps: A closing sentence can start with 'That is why' and restate the opinion in a new way.

items.prompt:
Which of these is the best opinion sentence about lunch?

A) I eat lunch at noon.
B) I think lunch is the best meal because it gives me energy to learn in the afternoon.
items.answer: B) I think lunch is the best meal because it gives me energy to learn in the afternoon.

steps: Sentence B has all three parts: opinion word ('I think'), topic ('lunch is the best meal'), and reason ('because it gives me energy').
